title: Carving out the Multifield Cosmological Collider Landscape
summary: We show that inflation with a large number of fields, as predicted by concrete ultraviolet embeddings, generically produces almost-local cosmological collider signals in the bispectrum squeezed limit. We construct the most general boost-breaking mixings between the curvature perturbation and $N_{\rm f}$ additional fields, and extract the late-time scaling dimensions that dictate the soft limits of cosmological correlators.
